newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-NEC Australia to export locally-made mobiles.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-NEC Australia to export locally-made mobiles.

text.p: NEC Australia Pty Ltd said on Monday it was set to launch Australia's first locally designed and manufactured digital mobile telephone.
NEC Australia, a subsidiary of Japan's NEC Corp, intends to export over 90 percent of the mobile telephones which it expected would generate A$35 million worth of sales a year.
The mobile telephones would be exported to Singapore, Thailand, Taiwan, Indonesia, Malaysia, Brunei, Vietnam, the Philippines and India, as well as Italy, Germany and Spain, NEC said in a statement.
